task: Add the missing window-manager policy: titlebars, drag/resize, close lifecycle, minimize, and maximize/restore.
acceptanceCriteria: Compositor owns clipped titlebars, frame, controls, hit-testing, capture, and painting without changing client pixel coordinates.
Resize is a staged Configure/Grant replacement/ConfigureAck transaction; active content remains unchanged until matching commit.
Close uses a client-visible request/response lifecycle; minimize/maximize/restore have explicit state transitions.
Existing background, focus, capture, cursor, Grant, and legacy surface behavior remains compatible.
RV64 QEMU evidence covers the complete policy and prior window-policy/cursor behavior.
blastRadius: Additive display ABI plus compositor input/render/lifecycle paths. Existing opcodes, ViSurface methods, SurfaceRole, input forwarding, grants, and public client coordinate origin must remain valid.
publicContracts: The user explicitly confirmed the additive public ABI change twice. New messages must use documented little-endian layouts, bounded title data, ownership checks, serial validation, and compatibility with existing clients.
